purpose: Research on statin use in COPD patients.
question: Among patients with COPD aged 65 or older, how many have an active statin, per hospital?
definitions: COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Statin = any medication with an ATC code starting with C10AA.
A medication is active if start_date is on or before 31 December 2025 and end_date is empty or after it.
Report per hospital: patients with COPD aged 65 or older, how many of them have an active statin and that share in %.
